title: Schedule of Releasing for Form 137 & Good Moral Certificates
summary: All students who submitted document requests online with status 'Ready for Release' may now claim their hard copies at Window 2 of the Office of the Registrar. Please bring your School ID and valid transaction reference.

title: Registrar Office Hours Advisory for Midterm Week
summary: Please be informed that office processing hours will be strictly from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Cut-off for same-day walk-in claim verification is 4:00 PM.

title: 2nd Quarter Academic Calendar & Grade Evaluation
summary: Faculty members are reminded to finalize student evaluation sheets. Certificate of Employment (COE) requests for teaching credentials are being processed.

title: Special Clearance Extension for Senior High Students
summary: Guidance and Library clearances may be submitted through the end of the month. Transferees requesting Form 137 are advised to clear all department holds.
